classification_rule.step1: Resolve word -> MOE entry (S2T lookup + one-level 參見/即/異體字/同 hop). No entry -> UNCLASSIFIABLE (no MOE headword).
classification_rule.step2: GLOSS region = 釋義 with 「…」/《…》/〈…〉 removed (witness gloss_region).
classification_rule.step3: Read ONLY the FIRST 'sense sentence' carrying any time token (split on 。！？newline + numbered-sense boundaries), so secondary senses (e.g. 夜's 形 昏暗的 / 動 夜行) do not leak. Receipt = that sentence, quoted verbatim.
step4_assignment_in_order: (1) FULL_CYCLE token present -> UNCLASSIFIABLE (spans day and night; e.g. 晝夜=日夜).

(2) span definition: a DUSK token AND a DAWN token both present -> if dusk before dawn = the NIGHT between = deep_night (e.g. 夜 '從天黑到天亮之間'); if dawn before dusk = the DAY between = daylight (e.g. 白天 '日出後，日落前').
(3) NOON_CORE present -> noon; elif DAY_CORE and NIGHT_CORE co-occur -> UNCLASSIFIABLE (spans); elif DAY_CORE -> daylight; elif NIGHT_CORE -> deep_night; elif twilight (DAWN/DUSK only) -> twilight.
classification_rule.rationale: boundary tokens are read as bounding a span, not as the class; noon is the most solar-specific; twilight is the least-specific (boundary-only) fallback. Nothing is guessed.
classification_rule.illum_poles_column: disclosure only (witness DARK/BRIGHT token scan on the gloss); NOT used to assign the class.
classification_rule.assert_nothing: Classes are DEFINITIONAL PROPOSALS; they claim nothing about any word's latent text-darkness.
